description: The shared opposite-profile sentence is satisfied exactly when every element has an element with the opposite truth value for the sole predicate.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.MonadicLogic.oppositeProfiles_realize.{u_1} {M : Type u_1}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang 1).Structure M] :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.Entry.MonadicLogic.oppositeProfiles ↔
    ∀ (x : M),
      ∃ y,
        (FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.predicate 1 0) fun x_1 => x) ↔
          ¬FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.predicate 1 0) fun x => y
